What is Sniper City?

Sniper City is a free online sniper game that runs in your web browser on a computer or a phone. Eight snipers start on the rooftops of one foggy Hong Kong block. An angel hangs above the city, and its halo closes in over a five-minute match. The last sniper alive wins.

  • PriceFree, no sign-up
  • Players1 to 8
  • ModesSolo against bots, online rooms with friends
  • Plays onDesktop and mobile browsers, no download
  • Match lengthAbout 5 minutes
  • Updated15 November 2026

How to play

Find the other snipers before they find you. Every shot leaves a red thread in the air that points back at whoever fired, so shoot and then move. There are no medkits: an elimination gives back 30 health. When the halo tightens, stay inside it or you bleed. Launch pads, ziplines, ladders and alley jumps link the roofs. Falling to the street kills you.

Controls

Keyboard and mouse: WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to fire, right click to scope, mouse wheel for 4× or 8× zoom, Shift to sprint or hold your breath, Space to jump, C to crouch, F for ziplines and ladders, R to reload, Q and E to peek, V for the hammer, G for a gas grenade, B for a decoy, T to play dead.

Phone and tablet: left thumb moves, right thumb looks, drag the fire button to aim and release to shoot. You can move, resize or hide every button, and turn on gyro aiming.

Weapons and powers

Every sniper carries a Ballista .338 bolt-action rifle, a Desert Eagle sidearm, a hammer, a gas grenade and a decoy. Solo matches add more: a scope with 30 seconds of thermal and night vision, an RPG-7 with two rockets, three dogs tied on rooftops that you can unleash and send after a tagged enemy, a half-time air drop with an AWM that kills in one shot through walls, a once-per-match prayer to the angel, and Lucifer, a flying form you earn with three gun kills in a row.

Play online with friends

Choose Play online, make a room and send the room code or link to your friends. Up to eight people can join one room. Empty seats can be filled with bots.

Questions

Is Sniper City free?
Yes. The whole game is free to play and needs no account.
Do I need to download anything?
No. It runs in the browser. Pressing Play loads about 15 MB of game files.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. It has touch controls and runs in mobile browsers such as Chrome and Safari.
Can I play alone?
Yes. Solo matches put you against seven computer-controlled snipers, and you can set how skilled they are.
How many players can join an online room?
Eight.
